_comment: LabVIEW ISO map for the Docker Windows-container clean room -- MIRRORED from ni/labview-icon-editor .lv-iso-map.json, then CORRECTED against the REAL LabVIEW 2026 offline ISO + nipkg 26.5.0 by the WIN plane. 'x86' = 32-bit LabVIEW. 'package' is the real installable nipkg META-package name (version-tolerant; the ISO has NO standalone nipkg.exe and NO 'LabVIEW_COM_PKG' package -- NIPM is bootstrapped from the ISO first). LabVIEWCLI ships as a SEPARATE NI product/ISO ('cli_package'), so a labview-cli=yes clean room installs BOTH. Nothing licensed is committed here; ISOs are fetched from NI / staged by the maintainer on a Windows host.
